messages:
leah: FYI paging on-call — Helios Financial reporting 5xx on their Dedicated pool (eu-west-1). Customer impact: failed inference calls, intermittent 500s since ~09:10 UTC. Paging @oncall.
incident-bot: @oncall page created: INC-2026-1769123456. Pager duty sent to omar. Runbook: dedicated-5xx -> start.
omar: Acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs now.
mira: I'll join. Oncall handoff note: I'm free for 30m then need to hand to alex for 2nd shift. Let's keep a crisp handoff.
omar: Quick snapshot: LB 502s with upstream errors from dedicated pool. Error rate spike coincides with autoscaler churn at 09:09. Seeing many grpc: "context canceled" in proxy logs.
omar: logs excerpt:
```
2026-05-14T09:09:12Z proxy[pod-7] ERROR upstream: connection reset by peer
2026-05-14T09:09:14Z runtime[worker-12] ERROR model: failed to allocate KV cache: OOM
2026-05-14T09:10:02Z gateway[proxy] WARN request_id=abc123 grpc: context canceled
```
mira: Looks like a memory pressure cascade — dedicated nodes scaled down, then pods restarted and warmed KV cache caused OOMs. Could be bad quantization profile applied in a recent canary.
leah: Helios is high-touch enterprise: account team on standby. Contacts below (routing):
- Primary ops: Samir Khan <samir.k@helios.com> (Slack: @samir_ops) +44 7700 111222
- CTO backup: Elena Costa <elena.c@helios.com> (email only)
- CSM: Priya N. (cc: priya@redwood) — working customer comms
sam: Noted. We'll hold customer-facing updates until we confirm mitigation path. Priya, can you prep a short impact blurb and statuspage draft?
priya (via sam): drafting now — will paste version for approval.
ops-runbook: Runbook step 1: confirm health of Dedicated pool VMs. step 2: snapshot recent scaling events. step 3: consider pinning to previous stable instance type or rollback updated quant profile. step 4: scale up with temporary buffer +1 pod.
omar: Executing step 1/2. Cloud API shows two scale-down events at 09:08 triggered by autoscaler policy 'scale-to-util-avg'. Investigating why the policy fired.
mira: While omar digs infra, I'm going to rollback the last model variant routing for Helios to the stable variant (model-xyz:v3 -> v2). That should reduce KV warmups and ram usage.
alex: FYI ops: if rollback doesn't materially reduce 5xx within 5m, plan B is to route Helios traffic to hosted fallback (hosted-eu model cluster) with traffic shaping — need approval from product for planned cost bump.
leah: Helios SLA note: 99.9% latency/availability. If we fail >5 minutes of sustained errors for their major route, escalate to enterprise-notify channel and legal ops. Keep precise timings.
omar: I can do immediate temporary scaling: bump node pool +2 to absorb warm-up. Applying now.
omar: cloudcli resize --cluster helios-dedicated --nodes +2
```
Request accepted: scaling to 6 nodes
```
mira: Rolling back model routing now:
```
redwoodctl route update --customer helios --model model-xyz:v2 --force
```
mira: Rolling. Watching metrics.
leah: Priya, statuspage draft when ready should mention: affected customer (Helios Financial), scope (dedicated inference for eu-west-1), user-visible symptom (500s / failed API calls), mitigation in-progress (rolling back model route + temporary scale-up), ETA: 10-15m for initial recovery.
sam: Suggested customer notification (internal draft):
"Helios ops — We're currently investigating increased 500 responses on your dedicated inference pool in eu-west-1. Engineers are rolling back a recent model routing change and scaling the dedicated pool to reduce failed requests. We expect partial recovery within 15 minutes. We'll send an update once traffic has normalized or sooner if anything changes. Contact: sam@redwood.com, priya@redwood.com."
leah: Add impact statement for enterprise comms: "No model outputs were exposed to other tenants. Data isolation intact. We believe this is an infrastructure scaling/quantization candidate issue affecting Helios's dedicated pool only."
incident-bot: Update: INC-2026-1769123456 status -> mitigation_in_progress. Pager silence scheduled for 10m.
omar: Metrics: 5xx rate peaked at 18% of requests. After scale-up + rollback, 5xx down to 6% and falling. Latency slightly higher due to warm caches.
mira: Confirming OOMs have dropped on worker pods. Some pods still show restart_count=1; new pods stable. I'm initiating canary traffic test:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer helios-token" https://eu-west1-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
mira: Canary result: 200 OK, response latency 320ms. Looks good for the canary.
leah: Great. Priya, can you convert the draft into a short customer email: subject: "Service disruption — Helios dedicated inference (eu-west-1) — mitigated" with timeline and next steps.
priya (via sam): sending initial update to Helios ops now (cc account team). Copy pasted email: "We experienced elevated 500 responses on your dedicated inference pool in eu-west-1 starting ~09:10 UTC. Our engineers rolled back a recent routing change and temporarily scaled your pool; error rates are returning to normal. We'll monitor for 2 hours and follow up with a detailed post-incident summary. If you see any further errors, please reply to this thread or call Samir at +44 7700 111222."
alex: Note to internal comms: prepare a postmortem if final incident window >30m. Assign to eng-runtime.
leah: Handoff plan: mira will own remediation until 09:40 UTC. After that alex takes follow-up and postmortem lead. Please add a short handoff message when you leave on-call so the next owner knows current state + open action items.
mira: Leaving at 09:40. Current status: 5xx at 1.2%, new pods stable, rollback complete, monitoring. Open actions: run 2h reconstruct for autoscaler decision, add guard in autoscaler to avoid scale-down within X minutes of scale-up for dedicated pools.
omar: I'll update the incident timeline and add the cloud events to the ticket. Also proposing a near-term config change: set min_nodes=3 for dedicated pools serving enterprise traffic.
leah: Final internal status (for now): Mitigation in progress -> customer notified. Next update scheduled 09:35 UTC or on major status change. If any regression, escalate to enterprise-notify.
incident-bot: INC-2026-1769123456 updated by mira. Severity: P2 -> continue monitoring.
leah: Thanks everyone. Priya will follow up with a short PS summary after 2h monitoring. Handoff note: mira -> alex at 09:40. :white_check_mark:
